runner_source.pin_role: declared Artemis runner; not the testcase source revision

fixture.target: X99 recyclable AVD; exact serial requires Sol's issue-visible grant
fixture.user_state: non-premium test state, confirmed through the app before the attempt
fixture.reset: Force-stop and cold-start before each attempt; each cold start resets show history; do not clear app data.

positive_case.trigger: One home feature click for a non-premium user, followed by a second click less than 20 seconds later.
positive_case.hourly_cap_coverage: not covered; this case tests the 20-second minimum interval only

negative_control.false_assertion: The first home feature click must be denied by Tinos rules (NOT_ALLOWED).
negative_control.intended_reason: The first click is allowed and logs show allowed: shown and dismissed; the deliberately false denial assertion must fail.
negative_control.adapter: Use the Tinos-specific log assertions in the journey and same-session native Checker evidence. Do not apply the Pocket Actual checker adapter unchanged.

execution.entry_point: Pinned Artemis direct CLI, standalone and collected in the foreground.
execution.session_policy: Use a unique session ID per attempt and preserve the same session for its Checker result and final capture.
execution.remaining_cli_arguments: Confirm from the pinned runner revision; this receipt does not guess flags that may vary by runner.

record_each_attempt: runner SHA and candidate commit SHA
source manifest version and candidate receipt digest
APK source commit, package ID, size, and SHA-256
target class, exact granted serial, session ID, and attempt kind
exact command, action timestamps, and observed event order
raw timestamped TinosDemo logcat, screen recording, and native traces
Checker verdict, Checker trace identity, and linked final-capture identity
cost, cleanup result, and verified device release
reporting.interpretation: An allow requires its exact allow log. A denial requires its exact gate log within 20 seconds of the first click. Fill-failure logs are neither. Keep the negative control's expected fail_assertion separate from the positive scenario's pass result.

execution_requires: Both independent reviews approve this exact testcase revision.
Sol completes the corrected-build re-review on CHE-2015.
Sol grants an exclusive exact-serial X99 AVD claim in the issue.
The executor verifies the pinned runner and APK identities before use.
The execution report preserves raw evidence and verified cleanup/release.
review_and_execution_boundary.android_cli_xml: separate experimental evidence; not an Artemis substitute
